comment: The Client Registry is presented as enabling correct longitudinal linkage for AI. Identity errors and probabilistic matching can produce unequal harms, particularly for people with incomplete, changing, or culturally diverse demographic information.

anchor.note: p.105 l.Lines 60-61 read as the printed page; section 5.2 agrees

public.text: The Client Registry is presented as enabling correct longitudinal linkage for AI. Identity errors and probabilistic matching can produce unequal harms, particularly for people with incomplete, changing, or culturally diverse demographic information.
public.suggestedRevision: Require evaluation of linkage accuracy, false matches, missed matches, demographic performance differences, human review, correction pathways, and exclusion risks before using linked records for training or inference.
